description: Source code for Wi-Fi Easy Connect (DPP) handling, including callbacks, context management, and utility functions for device provisioning and reconfiguration.

classes.name: wifi_device_dpp_context_t
classes.description: Context structure for managing DPP sessions and states.

classes.name: wifi_easy_connect_t
classes.description: Structure holding global configuration and context for Wi-Fi Easy Connect.

methods.name: set_dpp_device_context_states
methods.description: Sets the state and status fields in the device context and associated station configuration.

methods.name: process_easy_connect_event
methods.description: Handles Wi-Fi Easy Connect events, managing DPP authentication, configuration, and reconfiguration flows.

methods.name: process_easy_connect_event_timeout
methods.description: Handles timeout events during DPP processes, retries, and state transitions.

methods.name: is_matching_easy_connect_event
methods.description: Checks if a given event matches the criteria for processing.

methods.name: dppAuthResponse_callback
methods.description: Callback invoked upon receiving a DPP authentication response frame.

methods.name: dppConfigRequest_callback
methods.description: Callback invoked upon receiving a DPP configuration request frame.

methods.name: dppConfigResult_callback
methods.description: Callback invoked upon receiving a DPP configuration result frame.

methods.name: dppReconfigAnnounce_callback
methods.description: Callback invoked upon receiving a DPP reconfiguration announcement frame.

methods.name: dppReconfigAuthResponse_callback
methods.description: Callback invoked upon receiving a DPP reconfiguration authentication response frame.

methods.name: find_best_dpp_channel
methods.description: Selects the next best DPP channel for reattempts.

methods.name: start_device_provisioning
methods.description: Initializes and starts a DPP device provisioning session.

methods.name: destroy_easy_connect
methods.description: Placeholder for cleanup; currently does nothing.

methods.name: find_dpp_dml_wifi_ap
methods.description: Finds DPP configuration for a given access point index.

methods.name: find_dpp_sta_dml_wifi_ap
methods.description: Finds DPP station configuration for a given AP index and station MAC.

methods.name: init_easy_connect
methods.description: Initializes the Easy Connect module, registers callbacks, and prepares channels.

methods.name: get_easy_connect_best_enrollee_channels
methods.description: Returns the preferred channels for a given access point.
